en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town taken from a slightly elevated, tree‑covered slope. In the foreground are leafy trees, dirt paths and a few detached houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the middle distance a dense historic townscape with many gabled roofs is visible. Dominating the skyline are several large church buildings: to the left a massive church or cathedral complex with multiple towers, toward the center another church with twin towers, and to the right a prominent large church with a tall spire and long nave. Low hills or vineyards form the background horizon. Along the right vertical edge there is a handwritten or printed number sequence, but no clear caption on the front.
